q: How much CO2 does a naphtha steam cracker emit per tonne of ethylene?
title: Steam cracker: CO2 per tonne ethylene
short: IPCC Tier 1 defaults put a naphtha cracker at about 1.73 tonnes of CO2 per tonne of ethylene and an ethane cracker at about 0.95, mostly from furnace fuel. A real plant should use its own fuel gas meters and analysis, since furnace efficiency and fuel mix move the figure a lot.
audience: Petrochemical plants at Haldia, Dahej and Jamnagar, and polymer buyers asking for upstream figures

ul: Cracking furnaces burning the plant's own methane rich fuel gas, often the largest share.
Steam and power from captive plants.

p: Use metered fuel gas with its composition, as for any refinery gas, and add bought power and steam. The IPCC defaults are only for checking or when nothing is measured.
A cracker makes ethylene, propylene, butadiene and pyrolysis gasoline together. Split emissions by mass or energy, say which, and use the same rule every year.
